product_published_state_check.name: product_published_state_check
product_published_state_check.value: not "product"."is_published" or ("product"."review_state" = 'approved' and "product"."published_at" is not null)

variant_size_check.name: variant_size_check
variant_size_check.value: ("variant"."size_value" is null and "variant"."size_unit" is null) or ("variant"."size_value" > 0 and "variant"."size_unit" is not null)

price_adjustment_batch_commit_check.name: price_adjustment_batch_commit_check
price_adjustment_batch_commit_check.value: ("price_adjustment_batch"."status" = 'committed') = ("price_adjustment_batch"."committed_by" is not null and "price_adjustment_batch"."committed_at" is not null)

customer_order_contact_check.name: customer_order_contact_check
customer_order_contact_check.value: "customer_order"."person_id" is not null or "customer_order"."guest_phone" is not null

bank_transfer_claim_review_check.name: bank_transfer_claim_review_check
bank_transfer_claim_review_check.value: ("bank_transfer_claim"."status" = 'submitted' and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_by" is null and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("bank_transfer_claim"."status" in ('accepted', 'rejected') and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_by" is not null and "bank_transfer_claim"."reviewed_at" is not null)

payment_provider_authority_unique.name: payment_provider_authority_unique
payment_provider_authority_unique.where: "payment"."provider" is not null and "payment"."provider_authority" is not null

payment_provider_reference_unique.name: payment_provider_reference_unique
payment_provider_reference_unique.where: "payment"."provider" is not null and "payment"."provider_reference" is not null

inventory_reservation_resolution_check.name: inventory_reservation_resolution_check
inventory_reservation_resolution_check.value: ("inventory_reservation"."status" = 'active' and "inventory_reservation"."consumed_at" is null and "inventory_reservation"."released_at" is null) or ("inventory_reservation"."status" = 'consumed' and "inventory_reservation"."consumed_at" is not null and "inventory_reservation"."released_at" is null) or ("inventory_reservation"."status" in ('released', 'expired') and "inventory_reservation"."released_at" is not null and "inventory_reservation"."consumed_at" is null)
